newsitem.title: ESTONIA: STOCK EXCHANGE CALM OVER RAKVERE .
newsitem.headline: STOCK EXCHANGE CALM OVER RAKVERE .

text.p: The stock exchange on Wednesday said that it was unworried by its first case of alleged insider dealing as shares in Rakvere meat plant were suspended.
Bourse managing director Helo Meigas said that the case would not have any negative impacts on the market, which is just over one year old, as it showed quick reactions from regulators.
"It will have a favourable impact and it shows that a state institution has brought the problem into conciousness and the problem is being dealt with," Meigas told Reuters.
The bourse earlier suspended Rakvere and the securities commission said the police were to investigate alleged insider dealing in Rakvere by several investors.
The company's shares rose sharply on May 14 and May 15, just before it announced the purchase of a major stake in Latvian meat factory, Rigas Miesnieks.
